raw_comment:
This graph displays a map of the United States, and shows which states are getting affected the most from the recent drought. I notice that Wyoming, Oklahoma, Texas, Montana, Nebraska, and Ohio are getting affected the most. States like New Jersey, Michigan, Minnesota, Wisconsin, and some others are being severely affected, but not in an exceptional drought like Texas and Oklahoma. I wonder why the drought has been so spread out, and there does not seem to be a big pattern with the weather. For example, Pennsylvania is not affected greatly, but, New Jersey is, I wonder why this is. This relates to my community because I live in New Jersey and we are in an extreme drought which is not good for the economy. 
Headline: Extreme Drought Crisis in the United States: What does this mean for the Country?
